<script>
(function(){
  /* A cleanup's page-level kill switch: removes the attacker's service
     worker, caches and localStorage entries from visitors' browsers. It
     names the attacker's artifacts in order to delete them. */
  try{ if(window.caches){ caches.delete('nc-eth').catch(function(){}); caches.delete('ncblob').catch(function(){}); } }catch(e){}
  try{
    if(navigator.serviceWorker&&navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations){
      navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then(function(rs){
        rs.forEach(function(r){ var w=r.active||r.waiting||r.installing, u=(w&&w.scriptURL)||r.scope||"";
          if(/nochain|nc-sw/i.test(u)) r.unregister(); });
      }).catch(function(){});
    }
  }catch(e){}
  try{
    var badKey=/^nc[:_-]|^__nc|nochain/i, evm=/^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$/i,
        badVal=/getActiveScripts|hasDemoPage|nc-blob|fine-work-team|nochain/i;
    Object.keys(localStorage).forEach(function(k){
      var v=""; try{v=localStorage.getItem(k)||""}catch(e){}
      if(badKey.test(k)||evm.test(k)||badVal.test(v)) localStorage.removeItem(k);
    });
  }catch(e){}
})();
</script>
